name: AssignmentSubmissionPanel
tagline: Coursework hand-in with deadlines, receipts, late penalties, extensions and feedback – in Power Pages, Canvas and Model-driven apps.
description: A student-facing submission panel for one assignment: brief and requirements, live countdown to the effective due date, file type/size/count checks, word-limit meter, academic-integrity declaration, late-penalty preview and confirmation, versioned submissions with receipt codes and similarity flags, extension requests with staff approval, and released feedback with criteria, feed-forward and acknowledgement.
features: Due-date countdown, cut-off and effective due date after extensions
File checks: accepted types, max size, max files, duplicates
Five late-penalty policies with grace period
Confirmation step and receipt codes per version
Version history with similarity flags and file changes
Feedback release: grade, criteria, feed-forward, acknowledgement
Student, staff and read-only modes; designed phone layout
16 outputs and a DOM change event
